principles: Open on a concrete consequence using a topic-specific mechanism; show an observable result by three seconds. Do not force every opening into two lanes.
Follow one worked example through one mechanism. Explain technical terms after their visible purpose.
Reveal a useful consequence in the opening teaching beat. Avoid reading a list.
One main idea per scene; a production caveat that actually explains the trade-off.
End with one practical reference, diagnostic checklist or reusable calculation.
Use natural curious connected English, the configured voice, short phrase captions and clear space between visuals and subtitles. No invented benchmarks or company architecture.
Keep curriculum order and scope; use metrics as descriptive evidence, never a causal winner or a guarantee of reach.
Choose a debugging story, prediction or trade-off; vary premise, composition and ending rather than swapping script text in the same film.
Make the useful result clear before a contextual save/share prompt; avoid generic engagement bait.

baseline_snapshot.observation: Lifetime at snapshot, unequal post ages. Small sample.

editorial_observations.hypothesis: End on a useful calculation or diagnostic reference viewers can save.
Use familiar situations to explain an engineering mechanism without inventing company internals.

approved_reference.retain: Early clarity, one evolving example and practical utility; do not copy the exact two-lane composition.
approved_reference.transfer_form_only: Keep the current curriculum topic. Do not repeat the reference episode or a successful older topic.
approved_reference.not_sufficient: Palette, voice, readable cards and prompt instructions alone do not reproduce the approved story.

review_2026_10_27.finding: Unequal-age directional evidence, not causal proof. Lesson 07 delayed its first solution until 23.3 seconds and repeated setup.

research_2026_11_01.limits: Unequal post ages, tiny interaction counts, no causal winner. Test openings before duration/voice/theme changes.
